question: Do I empty the jug after sanitizing the inside with bleach?

before.text: Use food-grade containers, and never one that held chemicals such as bleach or pesticides. To sanitize: wash with soap and rinse. Mix 1 teaspoon of unscented bleach (5% to 9%) in 1 quart of water, close the lid, and shake so it touches every inside surface. Wait at least 30 seconds, pour it out, and let the container air-dry. Fill with safe water, close tightly, date it and replace home-filled water every 6 months.
